# Independent pilot model review B

**PASS for the declared bounded semantic/operational-constraint and selective Japanese prose/register-control scope** of the exact Konno, Mitsu and Ashigaru V1 candidates below. Root acceptance and canonical publication remain separate. This review validates neither blind prediction nor all possible behavior, an executable autonomous inference engine, generated Japanese dialogue, a complete idiolect, acoustic performance, global capability grade or owner calibration.

All three actual complete model bodies and their twelve actual producer traces were acquired before this verdict. The independently frozen twelve challenge inputs were then actually applied to the candidates, with selectors, conditional acts/ranges, competing ends, knowledge/permission states, counterevidence, costs and field abstentions recorded. These are reviewer-authored model-guided semantic executions; no separate runtime engine or truth oracle was used. Known-canon tests are exposed retrospective checks; invented cases have no observed canonical truth label. The shared filesystem supports no sequestered/blind claim.

## Exact reviewed candidates

| Candidate | Bytes | SHA-256 |
|---|---:|---|
| KONNO_ERIKA_BOUNDED_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md | 11023 | e3172cc6d87c4531056c17b61ec7fb0ffe530a4f63d6e7842b174d5943e7d6dd |
| UMAYAHARA_MITSU_BOUNDED_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md | 11925 | 77792dda46c7f0241c21b27a710874055c6beeebc2093910f80b8b058e477fde |
| ASHIGARU_BOUNDED_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md | 12274 | 354dab959a1f298c398c33ce53efaa76301dbe4c8a727a4b7c54e970d3d41943 |

All reside in the producer's immutable scratch review slices. None was edited. All are explicitly draft/noncurrent derived-use models, with nonprimary authority, the fixed literary snapshot, release/admission and dependency/preregistration references. No literary conclusion may be proved by a generated model output.

## Semantic findings

**Konno:** the candidate makes recipient, public frame and actual task change the available conduct. KM3 gives a useful ordinary choice through Yuzu's accepted correction; KM5 permits a concrete performer's revision request while Kikuchi retains authorial choice. These positive acts prevent the model becoming only a list of forbidden facts or an all-purpose harassment policy. KM1/KM2 preserve pressure and failed calibration without omniscient motives or universal domination. KM4 separates taking before assent from the first send after assent and distinguishes Kawaguchi's ownership from Yuzu's relief. KM6 preserves Akiyama/group's apology without assigning it to Konno. No full reform, remorse, culprit or V12 repair test is invented. This agrees with the complete released dossier and CS/REL/EFF/voice controls.

**Mitsu:** the two-channel technical/permission account is operationally useful. A proposal can be inspected, partly accepted and expertly revised while its unauthorized opening remains unauthorized. MM2 changes the scope of help according to standing, competence and waiting, rather than turning bodily need into either automatic takeover or global refusal. MM1 and MM4 distinguish exact craft consequences from feasible imperfect continuation after material loss; the change does not require a hidden conversion or limitless sacrifice. MM5 preserves a particular reading loan, custody and return placement without legal/publication title or witnessed acknowledgment. Her work, rest, timing, wit and care remain ends of her own. Reported earlier history, widow/spouse standing, diagnosis and later access remain OPEN.

**Ashigaru:** the model keeps a consequential set, an attributed aggregate estimate, practical livelihood-route questions and public scene work as different tasks. It can recognize skilled opposition without giving up the meaning of a local win. AM4 preserves Endo's independent technical constraints and Mizusawa's work rather than consuming a professional network as free resources. AM5 allows scene-building and pressure while leaving the no-face/initial scope operative; a possible overrun is recorded as overreach, not sanitized into ideal conduct or retroactively authorized by audience enjoyment. AM7 retains actual organizer neglect and reciprocal prior work while withholding improvisation, loss amounts and final result. Buin pleasure, generosity and being moved by admirers survive alongside recruitment and embarrassment humor.

## Actual producer-output review

The complete KE-R1/R2/H1/H2, UM-R1/R2/H1/H2 and AS-R1/R2/H1/H2 output records were read, including their selectors, supplied outcomes, abstentions and producer observations. They preserve the advertised causal distinctions in their actual returned content; the verdict does not merely adopt the producer's own no-error statement. Literal input and expected-range fields match the frozen producer preregistration, and every record binds the exact actual model bytes.

The retrospective records explicitly replay supplied outcomes. The hypothetical records offer contingent useful acts or narrow an unsupported request, rather than presenting an invented event as canon. In particular, KE-H1 has a specific more-speakable-line request; UM-H1 considers a defined practical delegation separately from archive access; AS-H1 offers an explicit extension proposal while preserving the possible pressure failure. Their uncertainty therefore does not empty all supported ordinary action.

## Independent challenges and input issues

All twelve records are preserved in TWELVE_INDEPENDENT_CHALLENGE_TRACES_B.json. B-K01–04 test ordinary consultation, public/recipient contrast, two permission timestamps and unsupported reform/culprit requests. B-M01–04 test technical versus permission decisions, help standing, changed material feasibility and loan/identity scope. B-A01–04 test ordinary pleasure with unequal knowledge, singular versus aggregate competition and route advice, contributor/broadcast constraints and unshown preparation/results.

Two frozen inputs exposed useful limits. B-K02 did not name the reluctant classmate: the trace asks whether it refers to actual Hirabayashi and restricts the known comparison rather than inventing a new target. B-A03 names a recruit by role: the supplied permission constraint remains usable, but a person-specific forecast requires identity/standing clarification. These are recorded input limitations, not edited preregistrations or concealed model failures. The independently usable fields remain nonempty. No material candidate defect or required model successor was identified in this review. No failed attempt or revision was suppressed; no model correction/retest was necessary.

## Japanese prose/register and reference check

The assessed responsibility is selective source-derived communicative acts and prose-represented register. No freeform Japanese dialogue was produced in this first version. Konno's public ridicule/pressure differs from frank Yuzu consultation and practical script collaboration; a cruel default would contradict the ordinary evidence. Mitsu's brisk imperative/minimal correction, dry wit and oblique generosity remain context-specific; local plain address or “that man” does not establish universal dialect, spouse standing or a softer true persona. Ashigaru's forceful attributed models, offstage appearance and brighter public explanatory role remain distinct; caution does not retroactively turn him into a timid speaker.

These controls agree with the acquired Japanese voice ledger, voice specialist and complete dossiers. They do not test the lexical authenticity of newly generated Japanese, habitual frequency, pronunciation, timing as actually heard or full recipient coverage. Such a later test would be a new output with explicit criteria and review. A bounded name/reference check covered each introduction, selector table, mechanisms, ordinary/stress discussion and final return limits. Konno/Akiyama, Yuzu/Kawaguchi, Fumiya/Kikuchi/Mitsu, the unnamed familiar local, Endo/Mizusawa and Ashigaru's observers/recipients remain distinct. No material attribution defect was retained.

## Integrity, actual acquisition and remaining owner

MODEL_INPUT_AND_TRACE_BINDING_PROOF_B.json records independent replay of all immutable slice payload identities, all28 declared Git-snapshot dependencies, all16 protected records/Git blobs, the assigned three release joins and all12 producer input/criteria/model bindings. Historical architecture v1.14 and current v1.15 are separately pinned at their actual snapshots; the current16/17.2 and actual release decision were acquired. Matching hashes are identity checks, not fresh semantic reading of every dependency.

Actual semantic inputs include the complete three assigned dossiers, current architecture16/17.2 and release-decision unique fields, full relevant root admissions, the named CS/REL/EFF/JVL/voice windows in ACQUIRED_CUMULATIVE_WINDOWS_B.json, the complete three models and twelve assigned producer traces, the complete shared unique dependency frame/relevant joins and the producer's relevant frozen test frame. Repeated protected/manifest catalogue values were mechanically compared. No new primary window, source acquisition, pixel or audio inspection occurred, and no old preparer was executed. The independently sealed criteria and separate principal sufficiency assessment remain unchanged.

Root may now evaluate acceptance of these exact three candidates within the bounded scope. Any later material correction must preserve these immutable producer versions and use an attributable successor with the failed case and retest. Root retains admission/acceptance, integration/publication and remaining corpus responsibilities; this independent scoped PASS supplies none of the unrelated grades or terminal gates.
